title: Amplification Program Preconditions
statement: For all natural numbers $cS,F$, Boolean values $os$, Boolean input words $x$, and abstract configurations $a$ with fifteen registers and labels indexed by $cS$ and $F$, the amplification program with each nondeterministic choice resolved in favor of false satisfies its precondition at $a$ on input $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is an abstract configuration with fifteen registers and labels indexed by $cS,F$
replaced:
For every $cS,F\in\mathbb{N}$, Boolean $os$, bit string $x$, and configuration $a$ with
$15$ registers and labels in the label set indexed by $cS$ and $F$, the nondeterministic
program obtained from the amplification program by resolving every choice in favor of
false satisfies the program precondition at $a$ on input $x$.
